name: AlgoDriven
description: AlgoDriven is a dealer appraisal and test drive management platform that helps automotive dealers value trade-ins and manage test drive/loan car fleets with confidence.

_published_faq.name: How do I add AlgoDriven to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add AlgoDriven to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.algodriven.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the AlgoDriven MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: AlgoDriven provides these MCP tools: get_bookings, get_drives, get_evaluations, and create_evaluation.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to AlgoDriven?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to AlgoDriven in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
AlgoDriven requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
AlgoDriven is developed by AlgoDriven. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
